label: Phase 1: requirements, rules, net classes, stackup, manufacturing

commands.name: ESP32 DevBoard (WROOM-32E, USB-C, CH340C) rev A

commands.text: R1 Module: ESP32-WROOM-32E-N4 (4 MB flash); PCB antenna overhangs the board edge; no copper on any layer and no parts under the antenna (Espressif hardware design guidelines).
R2 USB: USB-C receptacle, USB 2.0 full speed only; 5.1 kOhm pull-downs on CC1 and CC2; ESD protection (USBLC6-2SC6) on D+, D-, VBUS; D+/D- routed as a short 90 Ohm differential pair.
R3 USB-UART: CH340C (CP2102N not in library, see ASSUMPTIONS) with two-transistor DTR/RTS auto-reset (EN) and auto-boot (IO0).

R4 Power: VBUS 5 V -> SS14 back-feed Schottky -> +5V (header 5V pin) -> AMS1117-3.3 (>= 600 mA, 1 A rated) -> +3V3; 10 uF + 100 nF at LDO input and output; 10 uF + 100 nF at module 3V3 pin; 22 uF bulk near module.
R5 Controls: EN (reset) and BOOT (IO0) buttons; EN RC 10 kOhm + 1 uF; power LED on +3V3; user LED on GPIO4 (not a strapping pin).

R6 I/O: two 1x19 2.54 mm headers, DevKitC-style order; flash pins GPIO6-11 not brought out (NC on WROOM-32E); strapping pins (IO0, IO2, IO5, IO12, IO15) not used for on-board functions except IO0 boot.

R7 PCB: 2 layers, 1.6 mm FR-4, 1 oz copper, approx. 28 x 55 mm, GND pour both layers with stitching vias, JLCPCB standard 2-layer capabilities, mostly LCSC basic parts; every part with MPN and LCSC number where possible.
